author: TeIq
content:
## Background

The case-view label panel renders labeler display names so a moderator sees "Alt Text Labeler" instead of `did:plc:rh3vjqs4npfpmnkkmx4u4bzj`. Today the lookup is `app.bsky.labeler.getServices` per render. After #181, we want zero AppView round-trips on the render path. A local cache solves this.

## Task

Migration `polaris-backend/migrations/00000000000035_labeler_profiles.sql`:

```sql
CREATE TABLE labeler_profiles (
    did            TEXT        PRIMARY KEY,
    display_name   TEXT,
    handle         TEXT,
    description    TEXT,
    fetched_at     TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    refreshed_at   TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
```

Behaviour:
- On insert into `indexed_labels` (new src DID seen for the first time): trigger a background task that calls `app.bsky.labeler.getServices?dids=<did>&detailed=true` and populates the row.
- Stale-while-revalidate: rows older than 7 days get refreshed lazily on next read.
- Case-view JOINs `indexed_labels` with `labeler_profiles` on `src = did`.

## Rust quality

- `sqlx::query_as!` to project to a typed `LabelerProfile` struct.
- The background fetch task is a `tokio::spawn` from a single shared `mpsc::Sender<String>` (DID); a long-lived consumer drains it. One in-flight fetch per DID — coalesce duplicates with a HashSet guarded by a single `tokio::sync::Mutex` (this is the legitimate Mutex exception per `rust-quality` skill, document it).
- No `unwrap()`; transport failures log + leave the row unpopulated; the case-view falls back to raw DID.
- Test: insert into `indexed_labels`, assert a `labeler_profiles` row appears within 5s; second insert with same DID doesn't trigger a second fetch (coalesce).

## References

- AT-Proto labeler-view shape: `app.bsky.labeler.getServices` (response `views[].creator.{did, handle, displayName, description}`).
- The deleted `fetch_labeler_info_map` in `network_context.rs` is the reference for the HTTP shape — note the `&dids=` repeated-params bug (the AppView rejects comma-joined). Port the fixed URL builder.

## Acceptance

1. Migration applies cleanly.
2. After a label arrives from a new src DID, `labeler_profiles` has a row for it within 5 seconds.
3. Case-view panel renders display names with zero AppView calls on the render path.
